nodes.title: Read me
widgets_values:
RIGGED FBX + CLIP -> ANIMATED FBX

MIXAMO-NAMED RIGS ONLY.  It copies curves by mixamorig: bone name and
refuses an articulationxl rig, whose bones are bone_N: "Model does not
have mixamorig: bone names!" (run 2026-09-30).  Rig with the mixamo
template to use it.

model_fbx_path must be an absolute container path, such as
/app/output/rigged/name.fbx.  The node runs in UniRig's own
environment, where a relative path is not found.

UniRig ships five Mixamo clips and none of them are game cycles.  For
idle/walk/attack, drop clips into input/animation_templates/mixamo/ or
use mesh2motion's 176 CC0 clips.  scripts/list_animations.py prints
both libraries.

---

Apply a Mixamo animation to a rigged FBX whose bones carry
Mixamo names, which means one rigged with
skeleton_template='mixamo'. It copies curves by mixamorig: bone
name, with no retargeting, and refuses anything else: on an
articulationxl rig from mesh_rig_unirig.json it stops with
'Model does not have mixamorig: bone names!'
(output/rigged/unit_warrior.fbx with Capoeira, run 2026-09-30).
docs/reference/video-mocap.md covers the retarget that would
close that gap. model_fbx_path must be an absolute container
path such as /app/output/rigged/name.fbx: the node runs in
UniRig's isolated environment, whose working directory is not
/app, so a relative path is not found (the same run).
animation_file is a combo built from
input/animation_templates/mixamo/, which ships Breakdance,
Capoeira, Dying, Hip_Hop_Dancing and Mma_Kick; drop more .fbx
there and they appear in the list.
